hooks.cannotTell: billed tokens, or whether an output was cut that Claude then asked for again (see the rework check). A PreToolUse hook sees the call and its answer, not the size of the output a rewrite saves.

outputBytes.reason: A PreToolUse hook sees the call and its answer, not the tool output a rewrite later shrinks.

outcome.cannotTell: that a paused window is a fair comparison: the task mix of two windows is not the same, and a refusal is shown instead of a percentage when the windows are thin.

costUnits.relativeTo: the median of the hooks-on window = 100

verdict.reason: No paused window yet: pause the hooks for a day to compare matched days.

rework.cannotTell: whether any single repeat was caused by compression. Treat both figures as hints.

sources.cannotTell: how much of that share a hook removed, or whether the model needed the removed text. Compaction is not modelled, so a long session counts every result for every later turn.
sources.method: Size of each tool result divided by 4, times the assistant turns that came after it

upstream.note: Upstream's tokens-saved figure counts tool-definition exposure of MCP servers only. It says nothing about Bash, Read or billed tokens and is never added to the figures here.
